steps.instruction: You're standing in a real, already-built World -- the Showcase World, made of the same blocks you can place. Try adding one of your own: hover a face and click (or tap it on a touch screen).
steps.hint: Any flat face works -- click or tap it to place a block there.

steps.instruction: Nice. Add a few more, however you like -- there's no wrong way to build.
steps.hint: Keep clicking or tapping faces to keep adding blocks.

steps.instruction: Tab / Space -- or tap Menu, bottom-left -- opens the Rhombic Wheel. Everything you can do lives there.
steps.hint: Press Tab or Space, or tap the "Menu" label near the bottom-left corner.

steps.instruction: This World already has real, growing life in it. Open Grow in the wheel and plant something of your own too.
steps.hint: Open the wheel, choose Grow, then click or tap a face to plant a seed there.

steps.instruction: Now walk around what's already here -- yours and everyone else's. Open the wheel and choose Explore.
steps.hint: Open the wheel, then choose Explore.

completionMessage: That's the whole loop -- build, discover, explore. The rest is yours.
